id.description: Stable integration id, e.g. telephony_cucm, coda_video.

domain.description: Functional domain: telephony, monitor, video, weather, alarm_ingress, ...

adapter.description: Import path or logical adapter id resolved by the integration host.

capability_groups.description: Named, independently-activatable groups of capabilities (e.g. coda_video's `video` and `alarm_ingress`). Every listed capability must also appear in `capabilities`.

legacy_display_alias.description: A superseded product name kept for display only (e.g. Cayuga for coda_video, ADR-0016). Never used as an id.

mock.description: True for mock/simulation adapters that carry no vendor API.
